requirements.statement: Scaffold realization and AMCAS contracts from constrained templates.
Diagnose structural completeness before roots are finalized.
Distinguish schema-valid drafts from campaign-ready contracts.
Provide prose-to-contract examples without replacing canonical JSON.
Expose a thin strict agent tool adapter over active surfaces only.
Pin capability and profile registries in every agent sidecar.
Specify the orient-bind-validate-plan-gate-export agent loop.
Separate exact tool results and journal roots from chat memory.
Emit structured constraint evaluation traces.
Provide deterministic human-readable trace projections.
Compare two configurations with constraint-level reasons.
Support compact and expanded local verbosity without changing evidence.
Document safe contract supersession and migration.
Classify old contracts as supported, migration-needed, or rejected.
Define user-contract repair deltas and preserved invariants.
Keep old journal events valid under their pinned contract roots.
Document when each active surface is called and why it refuses.
Provide one minimal request/result and one misuse per active surface.
Provide a job-oriented operator playbook.
Keep progress, evidence, authority, and chat summaries distinct.
Bind ordinary test, typecheck, lint, coverage, SBOM, and CI artifacts.
Specify custom-verifier obligations and pinning.
Demonstrate hash-and-presence checking without semantic overclaim.
Demonstrate UNCERTAIN recovery without redispatch.
Demonstrate expected-journal-head refusal.
Demonstrate session export, import, and continuation boundaries.
Publish recovery anti-patterns.
Publish a machine-readable ABI and surface stability charter.
Publish canonicalization edge vectors and one canonical function rule.
Specify workspace layout, locks, heads, and safe deletion.
Require custody checks and expected head before stale-lock recovery.
Publish caller-time, freshness, skew, and boundary rules.
Publish idempotency key generation, scope, retention, and replay rules.
Provide budget refusal and rollback-required/forbidden examples.
Provide deterministic journal diff and campaign summary tools.
Fuzz parsers and verifiers toward typed refusal.
Define exact incremental revalidation or bounded full recomputation.
Publish hash-pinned shared policy packs and conflict checks.
Publish language-neutral formats and non-Python golden vectors.
Publish stable CLI exit codes.
Generate shell completions from the capability registry.
Pretty-print receipts and reports as non-authoritative projections.
Classify AMCAS and realization changes by semantic domain.
Verify an optional external human approval receipt when required.
Type disk-full and quota failures without claiming success.
Allow-list UCM environment variables and support strict refusal.
Exercise Windows and POSIX path, lock, and atomic-replace semantics.
Emit a stable EXPLAIN_SELECTION artifact.
Keep human approval external and non-granting.
Keep H_s, H_c, H_m, H_j, and H_r commitments separate.
Make all safety and claim boundaries hard admissibility requirements.
Use preference ordering only after CM1 membership passes.
Use targeted construction tests and one final cache-free qualification.
Reserve adversarial execution for the operator kit and independent reviewer.
Build deterministic software, journal, review, and operator artifacts.
Remain INFORMATION_ONLY, NONE, real A5 false, and G0 closed.
